scripts.postinstall: sh -c 'if [ -d simple-pdv ]; then cd simple-pdv && npm install; fi'
scripts.build: sh -c 'if [ -d simple-pdv ]; then cd simple-pdv && npx prisma generate && npm run build; else npx prisma generate && npm run build; fi'
scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ -d simple-pdv ]; then cd simple-pdv && npm start; else npm start; fi'
